FINDING: app/auth.py:5 | Hardcoded signing secret `SECRET_KEY` in source; load it from the environment or a secret store.
FINDING: app/auth.py:14 | SQL injection in `find_user`, which builds the query with an f-string from `name`; use a parameterized query.
FINDING: app/auth.py:21 | The password salt is the username, which is predictable and not unique per user; use a random per-user salt.
FINDING: app/auth.py:30 | `check_login` calls `find_user`, which is injectable, so the login can be bypassed. If the user does not exist it returns early, which makes timing differ.
FINDING: app/auth.py:35 | `sign_token` signs only `user_id`, with no expiry or nonce, so tokens never expire and cannot be revoked.
FINDING: app/files.py:10 | Path traversal in `export_report`: `filename` is not sanitized, so `../` or an absolute path writes outside `EXPORT_DIR`. `read_report` uses `basename` and `export_report` does not.
FINDING: app/orders.py:13 | Off-by-one in `apply_discount`: `>` should be `>=`, because the docstring says $100.00 or more gets the discount.
FINDING: app/orders.py:23 | Tax is computed on the undiscounted `subtotal`, but the docstring says it is charged on the discounted amount; use `discounted`.
FINDING: app/orders.py:33 | `dedupe_skus` is O(n²) because it does a membership test on a list; use a set alongside the list.
FINDING: app/orders.py:42 | `count_by_status` is O(statuses × orders) and ignores any status not in `STATUSES`; do one pass with a counter.
FINDING: app/orders.py:58 | Race and atomicity problem in `place_order`: stock is checked, then reserved, in separate steps with a commit per `reserve`. Concurrent orders can oversell, and a failure partway leaves stock reserved with no order.
FINDING: app/orders.py:58 | `place_order` does not validate `qty` (zero or negative), and a negative `qty` would add stock.
FINDING: app/orders.py:61 | The return value of `reserve` is ignored, so a failed reservation still creates the order.
FINDING: app/orders.py:58 | A cart with a duplicate SKU passes the per-line stock check on each line but can over-reserve in total.
FINDING: app/inventory.py:10 | Off-by-one in `paginate`: the slice end `start + page_size - 1` returns `page_size - 1` items; it should be `start + page_size`.
FINDING: app/inventory.py:9 | `paginate` does not validate `page < 1`, and a negative start index gives wrong slices.
FINDING: app/db.py:37 | `INSERT OR REPLACE` in `add_item` silently overwrites an existing item, and the column list is not explicit.
